statement: The per-feature GPU pilot on worker_b (PIN_df9ae31c) exited 2 before any update because the pinned worktree predictor-d-pin-df9ae31c did not exist on worker_b: it had been created only on worker_a and the orchestrating host. The launcher's cd failed, candidate generation raised ModuleNotFoundError (tools), and the admitted child could not open tools/modular_doin_cost_pilot.py.
impact: No GPU work, no update, no campaign row touched. The same gap would have broken every worker_b attempt of campaign d_ecl_l24_h24_corrected_r0_v1; its worker_b runner had not been started.
fix: RemoteExecutor.preflight: run-remote refuses to start a host runner when the pinned worktree is absent, not at the pin, or has modified tracked files (test_runner_preflight_refuses_absent_or_dirty_pin_worktree).
Per-feature pilot re-queued at its declared 6427M after the coordinator confirmed worker_b settled.
